name: roll_forward_period
representative_why: Users need the same workbook pattern to continue into the next week, month, quarter, or project phase.
representative_how: calculate formula-backed closing values when needed
write carried values into declared next-period opening cells
preserve non-mapped period values and formulas
concrete_workflows: roll a project tracker into the next reporting week
carry cash-flow closing balance into next period opening balance
carry budget closing or remaining balance into the next period control sheet
verification_strategy: Supported scope verifies declared closing values are carried into declared opening cells, source workbook hash is preserved, and non-mapped cells/formulas remain unchanged. Sheet creation, period label rewriting, input clearing, and automatic carry-forward inference remain outside supported scope.
